summary: Blackstone Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K to report the issuance of $750 million aggregate principal amount of 6.200% notes due 2031, under its base indenture supplemented by the Twenty-Second Supplemental Indenture. The notes mature November 15, 2031, pay semi-annual interest, and are unsecured general obligations ranking pari passu with existing unsecured debt. The offering closed August 19, 2026, under an effective N-2ASR registration statement. This is a routine debt capital raise, not a special situation, so the filing is categorized as None.
